focused_checks.trigger: Ordinary full-prefix hit resampling has accepted native work, then an observation/readback fails; the caller retries or destroys the Model while actual retirement is still unproven.
focused_checks.question: Can a reused frontier overwrite identity/modifier state, or can an omitted persistent Invocation root strand the ColdResources retirement owner?
focused_checks.result: No new defect found. The frontier pending guard precedes Invocation creation and identity writes; inputs are ready lease bindings. Accepted original Completion owns the retained cold scope. The frontier has no persistent Invocation field: sample_prefix creates a local run, so dropping that handle already removes the application Invocation root on success/error. ColdResources includes its frontier pending fact and receives the original Backend at Model teardown. This uses existing Completion retirement, not a new observer/manager or an error-as-retirement shortcut.

focused_checks.limit: No new native error injected; source ordering/lifetime check, not proof that every arbitrary unknown completion will eventually retire. MTP auxiliary-program changes are outside this review.

focused_checks.result: No new defect found. All fallible output admission, append recovery and expected-base checks precede batch head swaps and committed ledger flags. Abort retains the actual StepState/guards until native retirement; no first participant is published before a later export rejection. Complete Snapshot owns ColdResources before its PageRef/VersionRef/read fields and therefore releases it last. Backend keeps stable endpoint addresses and moves the original endpoint into the same cold owner on teardown. CPU system resource is process lifetime; CUDA owned domains use StorageOwner; other borrowed native-resource uses must keep their original endpoint as explicitly documented.
focused_checks.borrowed_boundary: Copying an internal LeasePool ReadLease alone is not a promise to own its MemoryResource/Context/allocator. The public pool contract keeps these borrowed; actual prefix/request consumers retain the complete Snapshot or original admitted native owner. LogitsInput explicitly requires an owned lease or a caller-retained borrowed endpoint. No second owner manager is missing from that declared contract.
focused_checks.accounting_boundary: Two-scope completed-result retention is not a physical provider cap. A first successful fee follows the actual export owner after second-gate rejection; persistent and transient exports may retain/return it differently. This is documented and not an atomic counter rollback guarantee.
